parts.script:
Emily: Hey, Mark! Have you thought about our weekend trip? I heard that the weather is going to be perfect for hiking. 
Mark: Yes, I was actually thinking of going to Oak Mountain. It has some great trails. 
Emily: That sounds wonderful! How about we leave early Saturday morning? 
Mark: Good idea. We could pack some sandwiches and snacks for the hike. 
Emily: Right! What do you think we should take? 
Mark: Let’s bring water bottles, some fruit, and maybe a couple of energy bars as well. 
Emily: Sounds like a plan! Should we invite Sarah and Jake too? 
Mark: Definitely! The more, the merrier. I’ll message them and see if they can join. 
Emily: Great! I can’t wait. Do you think we should check the trail conditions before we go? 
Mark: Absolutely, I’ll do that when I get home. We want to make sure it’s safe. 
Emily: Perfect. Let’s also pack a first-aid kit, just in case. 
Mark: Good thinking! Let’s meet at my place Friday night to finalize everything. 
Emily: Sounds good. I’ll bring the snacks!
